title: The Ass and the Grasshoppers

full_text:
An ass, enchanted by the chirping melodies of grasshoppers in the meadow, asked them: "What sweet nectar do you eat that gives you such musical voices?"

"We feed only upon morning dew," they chirped in jest.

The gullible ass resolved to eat nothing but dew. He grazed no grass, ate no thistles, and licked only dew from the morning leaves. Within two weeks, the foolish beast starved to death, proving that you cannot adopt another's diet without destroying your own life.
moral: Attempting to change your nature to imitate others brings only starvation.
